Name: More Pleasant Elevator Sound
Author: Aimon111
Description:
[size=3][b][u][color=#ffe599]IMPORTANT: 
[/color][/u][/b][u]This mod will replace the "Crystal" sound completely (so singing stones sound will be replaced too). In order to fix it - I recommend you to download  [/u][u][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24972]Customizable Elevator Bell Ding Sound Replacer[/url] mod made by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/134910173]pneuma163[/url] and replace one of the .wav files with .wav file from my mod.[/u]

Replaces the mines elevator sound to be less... "ding" sound.

You can [url=http://sndup.net/c4bx]listen it here![/url] (It may sound loud but in game it's just perfect)

So... I bought me new headphones the other day. And they were very nice! Untill I started playing Stardew and went to the mines - for some reason in these headphones the vanilla "ding" sound became elongated high pitched ringing in my right ear (if that explanation makes sense to you). Dunno if that's the issue with headphones or this sound was always like so but I made a "fix" for it. 


[i][b][u]Note:[/u][/b][/i] mod will also replace the sound of [url=http://stardewvalleywiki.com/Singing_Stone]Singing Stone[/url] furniture and any other object which uses same sound (the sound called "crystal" in game code)


Got this sound somewhere at random freesound site (I don't remember where exactly, sorry).[/size]

Downloads.Description: fixed issue with sound aren't being replaced properly sometimes
